overrides.reason: All Territories are revealed during setup in v0.6, so the earlier rule about unrevealed Territory triggers no longer governs current play.
The current card visual system requires a small faction emblem on faction cards.
Completing the third Rite no longer wins immediately; a later Ritual of Ascendance and a battle win are required.
The v0.6 Asset Bank uses a fixed normal limit of three and no longer changes with Territory control.
